preconditions.description: The input num must be an integer.
The input num must be a non-negative integer less than 2^31 - 1.

postconditions.description: The return value must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Zero' if num == 0 else (return_value != '' and return_value[0].isupper() and return_value[-1].isalpha() and ' ' not in return_value.split() and all(word in ['One','Two','Three','Four','Five','Six','Seven','Eight','Nine','Ten','Eleven','Twelve','Thirteen','Fourteen','Fifteen','Sixteen','Seventeen','Eighteen','Nineteen','Twenty','Thirty','Forty','Fifty','Sixty','Seventy','Eighty','Ninety','Hundred','Thousand','Million','Billion'] for word in return_value.split()))
postconditions.description: The return value is the English word representation of num, with 'Zero' for 0, otherwise a non-empty string starting with an uppercase letter, ending with a letter, containing only space-separated words from the standard set of number words, with no empty tokens.

postconditions.expression: num == 0 or (return_value != 'Zero' and 'Zero' not in return_value)
postconditions.description: The word 'Zero' appears only when the input is 0.
